regions.note: Spans all phases because it is true of all of them.

invariants: Exactly one phase is tinted, and it is the CURRENT one. Without it this is a four-column table rather than a sequence — the tint is the only thing saying 'you are here'.
Ordinals carry the sequence. A drawn time axis implies durations nobody has measured; numbering does the job honestly.
Activities are separated by hairlines, never bulleted. A rule says peers in a list; a bullet says subordinate to something above, and nothing is above them.
The footer band spans the full width. It names what underpins every phase, which is a different kind of claim from anything inside a column.
